+  # capability gate (ADR-0055/P5): after exhaustiveness, refuse any function with a

@@ -564,4 +581,46 @@ mod SelfhostComposeRealSum do
   def dup_wild(Int53) Vec(Pat)
   def dup_wild(0) := []
   def dup_wild(n) := [PWild | dup_wild(n - 1)]
+
+  # ── capability gate (ADR-0055/P5) — the verified SelfhostCap.beam_legal, in-loop ──
+  # The first function with a parameter whose capability is not BEAM-legal (`ref`),
+  # else "". Caps live on the typed head (DSig/DFunc); pattern clauses carry none.
+  def first_illegal_cap(decls Vec(Tuple)) String
+  def first_illegal_cap([]) := ""
+  def first_illegal_cap([{:d_sig, _, name, params, _, _} | rest]) := cap_or(name, params, rest)
+  def first_illegal_cap([{:d_func, _, name, params, _, _, _} | rest]) := cap_or(name, params, rest)
+  def first_illegal_cap([{:d_mod, _, inner} | rest]) := mod_cap(first_illegal_cap(inner), rest)
+  def first_illegal_cap([_ | rest]) := first_illegal_cap(rest)
+
+  def cap_or(name String, params Vec(Tuple), rest Vec(Tuple)) String
+    if params_legal(params) do
+      first_illegal_cap(rest)
+    else
+      name
+    end
+  end
+
+  def mod_cap(inner String, rest Vec(Tuple)) String
+    if inner == "" do
+      first_illegal_cap(rest)
+    else
+      inner
+    end
+  end
+
+  def params_legal(Vec(Tuple)) Bool
+  def params_legal([]) := true
+  def params_legal([{:par, _, cap, _} | rest])
+    if SelfhostCap.beam_legal(to_cap(cap)) do
+      params_legal(rest)
+    else
+      false
+    end
+  end
+
+  def to_cap(s String) Cap
+  def to_cap("iso") := Iso
+  def to_cap("ref") := Ref
+  def to_cap("tag") := Tag
+  def to_cap(_) := Val
 end

+
+  describe "the capability gate is wired (ADR-0055/P5) — a BEAM-illegal `ref` is REJECTED" do
+    test "build refuses a function with a `ref` parameter (raise {:not_beam_legal, name})",
+         %{drv: drv} do
+      bad = "def f(x ref Int64) Int64 := x"
+      assert catch_error(drv.compile_module(bad, :CapBad)) == {:not_beam_legal, "f"}
+      assert catch_error(drv.build(bad, :CapBad2)) == {:not_beam_legal, "f"}
+    end
+
+    test "val/iso/tag parameters are BEAM-legal and compile + run", %{drv: drv} do
+      m =
+        drv.build(
+          "def f(x iso Int64) Int64 := x\ndef g(y tag Int64) Int64 := y\ndef h(z Int64) Int64 := z",
+          :"Caps_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
+        )
+
+      assert m.f(5) == 5
+      assert m.g(7) == 7
+      assert m.h(9) == 9
+    end
+  end
 end
